cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Losing the entry fee bought us a complete map of the competition. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. A short-term interpretation of the investment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the information has become exclusive. We'll use it selectively.

mechanism: A calls a lost contest fee paid reconnaissance, adapts to no further funds through free-entry planning and asks B to use the knowledge for a future win.
confusable: Unlike merely avoiding the score, A explicitly makes the defeat an intentional purchase for later victory.
comparison: Competition notes and free-entry search differ from loss-making stall sale and next business choice.
seedUse: D209-a fee, competition map and no money; S02-a takes searching work while letting B choose the next target.
